text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at gains and later buying it back at a higher price showed me that taking profits without a clear re-entry plan can hurt; I should assess the stock’s current prospects before both selling and buying.","I sold Stocks C and A after steep losses, then bought Stock C again. I should make each decision from the outlook and risk today, not from a wish to escape a loss or recover it.","My account fell substantially despite several profitable sales. I should track total portfolio performance and whether my holdings are appropriately diversified, rather than treating individual winning trades as proof my approach is working."]}
